purpose: Pinned tools and PDK for PEWeaver Phase 3 physical-flow bring-up (PHYSICAL_PPA_PLAN.md). The run script must verify these pins before running; a mismatch fails closed.

pdk.name: sky130A
pdk.notes: All corners (ff/ss) installed; only tt_025C_1v80 + nom is used for the baseline study. RCX extraction rules pinned from the OpenROAD-flow-scripts sky130hs platform (referenced by the ORFS sky130hd platform).

orfs_platform_files.pinned_ref: master as of 2026-08-29; files copied byte-for-byte into physical/pdk/sky130hd/

files.setRC.tcl: layer/via RC values used for pre-route estimation
files.pdn.tcl: power grid definition (met1 followpins, met4/met5 stripes)
files.fastroute.tcl: global routing layer adjustment and routing layers
files.rcx_patterns.rules: OpenRCX extraction patterns (from sky130hs platform, referenced by sky130hd)
files.config.mk: ORFS platform configuration, kept for provenance reference only

orfs_platform_files.resolution_method: Commit resolved via GitHub API (repos/.../commits/master) on 2026-08-29; not rate-limited. Upstream path prefix: flow/platforms/. In ORFS, sky130hd/rcx_patterns.rules is a symlink to ../sky130hs/rcx_patterns.rules, so the upstream comparison fetched flow/platforms/sky130hs/rcx_patterns.rules; the local copy is a materialized regular file whose bytes match that target exactly. All seven local files are byte-for-byte identical (cmp) to the upstream copies at the pinned commit; hashes were computed over the local files actually used by the flow.

yosys.distribution: YosysHQ OSS CAD Suite, workspace-local install

verilator.distribution: YosysHQ OSS CAD Suite, workspace-local install
